# Status machine

Canonical OLIP handoff status machine. Normative. A state may change only through a transition listed here, from an allowed source, carrying the listed evidence. Nothing may be inferred from another state.

Machine-readable file: [`status-machine.json`](pathname:///spec/0.1/status-machine.json).

## Sources

| Source | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `user` | The consumer, proven by an out-of-band approval the calling agent cannot produce on its own. |
| `client` | The authenticated calling agent platform acting for the user. |
| `host` | The OLIP endpoint that stores the handoff. |
| `transport` | A delivery channel (for example email or a webhook) that reports acceptance or failure. |
| `recipient_system` | The recipient law firm's intake system, proven by a signature or an authenticated call. |
| `recipient_human` | A person at the recipient firm, recorded by the recipient system with an authenticated call. |

## States

| State | Terminal | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `draft` | no | Preview exists. Nothing approved, nothing transmitted. |
| `approved` | no | The user approved this exact recipient, fields, purpose and notice version. Nothing transmitted yet. |
| `recorded` | no | Stored by the host and held (for example waiting for a policy gate). Not scheduled, not transmitted. |
| `queued` | no | Scheduled for transmission. One or more attempts may have failed. Not yet accepted by any channel. |
| `sent` | no | A transport accepted the message. No proof it reached the recipient's system. |
| `delivered` | no | The recipient's intake system stored it and returned a verifiable receipt. No proof any person read it. |
| `acknowledged` | no | A person at the recipient firm recorded that they viewed it. Automatic replies never count. Not acceptance of the matter. |
| `responded` | no | A person at the recipient firm sent a substantive reply. Not acceptance of the matter. |
| `declined` | yes | The recipient said it will not take the matter. |
| `consultation_requested` | no | A consultation was proposed. Not yet agreed. |
| `consultation_confirmed` | no | The recipient confirmed a consultation time. Not an attorney-client relationship. |
| `completed` | yes | The recipient recorded that the consultation took place. Says nothing about engagement or outcome. |
| `cancelled` | yes | The user withdrew. If anything was already transmitted the recipient may keep a copy; see cancellation.effect. |
| `failed` | yes | Transmission could not be completed after the allowed attempts. |
| `expired` | yes | The approval or hold window ended before transmission. |

States that mean something left the host: `sent`, `delivered`, `acknowledged`, `responded`, `declined`, `consultation_requested`, `consultation_confirmed`, `completed`.

Anything not listed here MUST be refused with `OLIP_INVALID_TRANSITION` or `OLIP_EVENT_SOURCE_FORBIDDEN`.

## Recipient event types

Events that only an authenticated recipient (its intake system or a person at the firm) may record: `acknowledged`, `responded`, `declined`, `consultation_requested`, `consultation_confirmed`, `completed`, `cancelled`. The calling agent can never record them.
